input.text: "A bone. So it was." The old woman doesn't seem embarrassed to have had it wrong. "Third stone up, all the same. Keep the spoon, then — it'll catch the light longer than I will." She turns back to the valley and says nothing more.

items.text: Let the world own its mistake: one line where the old woman accepts Gavin's correction about the bone and then goes quiet — then left him to it.
